name: Patchwork

categories.label: Buttons
categories.help: One point for each button you hold.

categories.label: Special tile
categories.help: Tick if you took the 7x7 bonus tile (7 points).

categories.label: Empty spaces
categories.help: Uncovered squares on your quilt board, each costing two points.

categories.label: Reached the end first
categories.help: Tick if you reached the final space of the time track first; this wins a tie.

notes: Two players only. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
